note: claim_stp / hitl use hard HITL only (INVALID/MISSING/exact-miss). PENDING is extraction plumbing, not production HITL. Exact provider_npi values that fail synthetic V2 Luhn are excluded from hard HITL (counted in synthetic_npi_luhn_exact).

metric_definitions.raw_claim_hitl: validation_status not AUTO_ACCEPTED (PENDING counts) — NOT production STP
metric_definitions.hard_claim_hitl: INVALID/MISSING/exact-miss only; synthetic exact NPI Luhn INVALID excluded
metric_definitions.claim_stp_proxy: 1 - hard_claim_hitl (Golden Pack proxy, not cascade true STP)
